sources.title: Deep jobs cuts at WCPO-TV part of Scripps' nationwide cuts
sources.description: Half of Channel 9's photo staff was eliminated along with producers, editors and other newsroom staffers as Scripps eliminated 431 jobs Tuesday.

sources.title: Scripps Raises Political Guidance After ‘Final’ 2026 RIF | Radio & Television Business Report
sources.description: With the opening of U.S. financial markets on Wednesday, investors and impacted Scripps staffers are digesting the news that some 400 employees were let go on October 27. Scripps acknowledged the layoffs early Wednesday, and also shared a positive update on political advertising guidance.
